verdict.rationale: Jules runs each task in an isolated cloud VM and offers an API for dispatching many tasks/automating workflows (jules-docs-3, jules-docs-9), and users report running multiple tasks/PRs in parallel (jules-comm-2, jules-comm-11, jules-comm-16). However, throughput is capped by daily task limits that were cut from 60 to 15 for free users (jules-comm-8, jules-docs-13), and community feedback notes agents getting stuck or needing babysitting on complex/monorepo work, limiting true scale-out reliability (jules-comm-13, jules-comm-14, jules-comm-18).
